sentences.text:
Another Counsel for Applicant :- Smriti Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
Heard learned counsel for petitioners as well as learned Additional Government Advocate for State.
The present 482 Cr.P.C. petition has been filed by the petitioners to quash the impugned summoning order dated 22.11.2023 in Complaint Case No.4622 of 2022 under Sections 498A, 323,
504, 506 IPC, 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Wazirganj, Lucknow.

Learned counsel for petitioners, after arguing for some time, submits that present petition may be dismissed as not pressed with liberty to file a bail application which may be decided in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in Satender Kumar Antil versus Central Bureau of Ramesh Jayswal @ Rsamesh Chandra ... vs State Of U.P. Thru.Prin.Secy. Home And ... on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89009631/
1 Investigation and another Special Leave to Appeal (Cri)No.5191 of 2021, to which learned A.G.A. has no objection.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil versus Central Bureau of Ramesh Jayswal @ Rsamesh Chandra ... vs State Of U.P. Thru.Prin.Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above, prayer for quashing the impugned proceeding is refused.

So far as other prayer is concerned, it is provided that in case the petitioners appear before the trial court within two weeks' from today and bail application is filed, the same shall be decided expeditiously, in view of the law laid down by Supreme Court in Satender Kumar Antil's case (supra).
The petition is disposed of accordingly.
